introHtml: Recycled cotton shirts offer the same soft, breathable feel as conventional cotton but with a significantly lower environmental footprint. Made from post-industrial or post-consumer fabric waste, this material is ideal for companies seeking sustainable apparel without sacrificing comfort or style. Whether you're outfitting a volunteer team or creating branded merchandise for a green initiative, recycled cotton shirts provide a durable canvas for screen printing or embroidery. The Ladies Montauk Henley is one popular option that combines eco-conscious materials with a relaxed, versatile look.
